# nixos

Option values are NixOS's: see [search.nixos.org](https://search.nixos.org/options). Usage: [Linux and macOS helpers](../reference/nix.md).

## nixos()

Any NixOS options, as an object: `nixos({ hardware: { bluetooth: { enable: true } } })`.

```ts
nixos(config: NixosOptions): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## nixos.imports()

Import NixOS modules (`inputs.x.nixosModules.y`, or module paths).

```ts
nixos.imports(imports: string[]): Fragment
nixos.imports(...imports: string[]): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## nixos.program()

Enable a NixOS program, with its options: `programs.<name>` with `enable = true`.

```ts
nixos.program(name: string, opts?: ProgramOptions<NixosProgramOptions, K>): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## nixos.service()

Enable a NixOS service, with its options: `services.<name>` with `enable = true`.

```ts
nixos.service("openssh", { settings: { PermitRootLogin: "no" } });
```

```ts
nixos.service(name: string, opts?: ServiceOptions<NixosServiceOptions, K>): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## nixos.packages()

nixos.packages(...packages: PackageRef[]): Fragment

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## nixos.systemd()

### nixos.systemd.tmpfiles()

tmpfiles.d rules and links (`systemd.tmpfiles`).

```ts
nixos.systemd.tmpfiles(rules: (string | NixExpr)[]): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

#### nixos.systemd.tmpfiles.link()

Keep a symlink at `path` pointing to `target`, via
`systemd.tmpfiles.settings.winix."<path>"."L+".argument`.

```ts
nixos.systemd.tmpfiles.link("/usr/bin/bash", "/run/current-system/sw/bin/bash")
```

```ts
nixos.systemd.tmpfiles.link(path: string, target: string | NixExpr, options?: TmpfilesLinkOptions): Fragment
```

**`options`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `replace?` | `boolean` | Replace whatever is at the path (`L+`, the default); `false` only creates a missing link (`L`). |

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.
